results.title: Allegheny County DA Zappala says city financial inquiry ongoing, Daphy Michel death under review
results.description: Allegheny County District Attorney Stephen Zappala says he aims to be ready “by next week” to talk about the death of Daphy Michel, a Haitian immigrant who died after being kept in federal custody. But Zappala offered a much more open-ended timeline on another case of public interest, a shrouded investigation into the City of Pittsburgh.
